payload.body: vc's WORD for 0112's heavy: the second bank (F 6f301dab5ab5, notes 66497e9c05b5, fix ff4c4f031020, tests e528d8236fc6, whole 3bf33ff89d19, run d88687104bee) is checked against the first. Ask your heavy slot through molt-vc: /bin/bash ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/0112-bank/run-0112.sh, kill timeout 3000 s, named with F and whole.patch's hash; START and END to molt-vc and vc.
